programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Wild Cats of India
programme.desc: A two-part documentary directed by photographer and filmmaker Sandesh Kadur, winner of the 2017 BAFTA award for his work on the program "Planet Earth 2".Wild cats have been considered a symbol of strength and royal power in India since ancient times.There are various species of them in this country.Viewers will learn the secret life of these fascinating animals.The creators of the document will pay special attention to lesser-known representatives of wild cats.Among them will be the Pallas cat, a small predatory mammal with short and massive legs found in Asia.Viewers will also learn about the spotted cat, which is protected by the Washington Convention.This species occurs, among others, in tropical forests and swamps, and to catch prey it jumps into the water.The clouded leopard, which feeds on monkeys and birds, is also a highly endangered species.These cats can, among other things, run headfirst down a tree.

programme.title: Animal fights
programme.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Migrating animals create one of the most beautiful spectacles of nature.All creatures migrate to survive.It happens on land, in the sea and in the air.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programme.title: Europe From Above 4
programme.desc: The creators of the series will present Scotland, Denmark, Serbia, Belgium, Bulgaria and Romania from a bird's eye view.They will use, among others, modern drones.Viewers will see the greatest cultural and geographical national treasures.They will see how tradition, engineering and nature have shaped these places.In the first episode they will go to Scotland.They will soar over the town of St Andrews and see how gardeners look after the famous golf course.In East Lothian they will see natural treasures, including honey bees feasting on heather flowers.They will then investigate an ambitious engineering project that harnesses the power of the ocean to generate electricity.A team of archaeologists will reconstruct a traditional Scottish house.

programme.title: Sardinien - Arche aus Stein
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Sea, as the only body of water in the world, has witnessed such intense, continuous and extensive climate changes, the merging of sea currents, the intertwining of ecosystems, nations, cultures, ideas and genes.About 40 million years ago, Sardinia broke away from the southern tip of Europe and began moving towards Africa.During its journey, the island, like a great rock ship, collected various passengers from land and sea.The creators of the documentary will talk about this second largest island in Italy, which is eagerly visited by holidaymakers.Its diverse coastline includes, among others, impressive cliffs and picturesque beaches.Viewers will see, among others, a colony of flamingos and the famous rock falcons.They will also visit donkeys from the island of Asinara, and wild boars, mouflons and griffon vultures in the forest.They will see the largest herd of wild horses in Europe and caves containing cave changelings and fossils of a species of giant deer that became extinct in Sardinia in the Stone Age.

programme.title: America's National Parks
programme.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses.
